footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Victory Capital: after $59.9M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 46.2% to $1.3B in 2025. Operating income rose 11.9% to $478M, a 36.6% margin.
Net income fell 6.5% to $270M, or $4.08 per share. Operating cash flow was $385M and free cash flow $381M, versus $339M; Victory Capital returned $353M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Victory Capital Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
